`person:joel-greenblatt` | confidence: **single-source** | tags: us, process, value, special-situations, weak-factor

Gotham Capital (1985): ~50% annualised over its first decade, per Greenblatt's own book You Can Be a Stock Market Genius (1997) - self-reported, not audited (confidence: single-source); outside capital returned in 1994-95. Structural edge (early): small fund size allowed meaningful positions in spin-offs, restructurings, rights offerings, merger securities and LEAPS where institutions are forced or uninterested sellers. Process: find situations where the seller is not price-sensitive (parent shareholders dumping spin-off shares, index deletions), concentrate in 6-8 names. Later the Magic Formula (The Little Book That Beats the Market, 2005): rank by return on capital (EBIT / net working capital + net fixed assets) and earnings yield (EBIT / EV), buy the top 20-30, rebalance yearly; backtest 1988-2004 ~30.8%/yr vs S&P ~12.4% (backtest, not live). Live results of formula funds and many replications were far weaker and long periods of underperformance made most users quit. Mistakes: the public long-short Gotham funds lagged in the 2010s growth era (unverified magnitude). Copyable for an Indian individual: spin-off and demerger watchlist (Indian demergers often sell off as funds exit the new listing), rights-issue and open-offer arbitrage; Magic-Formula-style screen as an idea generator, not a black box.

| key | value |
|---|---|
| track_record | ~50%/yr 1985-1994 (self-reported) |
| magic_formula_backtest | 30.8% vs 12.4% 1988-2004 (backtest) |
| mistakes | live formula lag; quitting behaviour |
| copyable | demerger/spin-off watchlist, ROC + earnings-yield screen |

body:
`case_study:waaree-premier-energies-2024-2026` · tickers: WAAREEENER, PREMIERENE · confidence: single-source

Not multibaggers for public investors. Waaree Energies: IPO Oct 2024 at ₹1,503; first weekly close ₹2,890; ATH ₹3,634 (Sep 2025); ₹2,433 on 19 Nov 2026 (1.6x the issue price, −33% from ATH). TTM EPS ₹37.5 → ₹135.6 (3.6x) while P/E fell from 84 to 18. Premier Energies: IPO Sep 2024 at ₹450; first close ₹1,096; ATH ₹1,325 (Jan 2025); low ₹683 (−48%); ₹830 now. EPS ₹12.8 → ₹39 (3.1x) while P/E fell from 214 to 21. Operations were excellent: Waaree revenue ₹14.4k cr (FY25) → ₹26.5k cr (FY26), OPM 19–22%; Premier OPM ~30%. The multiple engine ran backwards: listing P/Es priced in years of supernormal solar-manufacturing margins, which were protected by import duties/ALMM and US demand, while industry-wide module and cell capacity announcements (visible in MNRE lists and company press releases) signalled future margin pressure (narrative unverified). Most of the multibagger return went to pre-IPO holders. Lesson: a sector at peak policy support plus IPO-time P/E of 80–200 means EPS can triple and the stock still go nowhere. The twin engine needs a low starting multiple.

Key data: **start_year**: 2024; **end_year**: 2026; **start_price**: WAAREE 2890 (issue 1503) / PREMIER 1096 (issue 450); **end_price**: 2433 / 830; **multiple**: ~0.8x from first close (1.6x / 1.8x vs issue); **pe_start**: 84 / 214; **pe_end**: 18 / 21; **eps_multiple_implied**: 3.6x / 3.1x; **max_drawdown**: -37% / -48%; **early_signals**: warning: industry capacity race + IPO-time P/E; **ended**: n/a; **lesson**: P/E engine can fully offset 3x EPS

Sources: <https://www.screener.in/company/WAAREEENER/consolidated/> · <https://www.screener.in/company/PREMIERENE/consolidated/>

- **id:** `thesis:paper-call:LUPIN:q3fy27-ebitda-margin-24pct-plus`
- **Method:** management-tone-vs-delivery · **P(ours)** 0.35 · **P(base)** 0.60 · resolve by 2027-02-28
- **Evidence:** Q2 FY27 call (Nov-2026): Q2 EBITDA ex-forex/other income ₹1,957 cr, margin 25.1% vs 31.3% a year ago; FY27 margin guide 'around 24–25%' with CEO Vinita Gupta saying margins 'likely to moderate in the coming quarters' (US competition in key products, R&D ~8% of sales, input costs). Screener OPM path: Mar-26 33%, Jun-26 30%, Sep-26 26%. US revenue guide $1.1–1.2 bn.
- **Why our number differs from base:** Management is telling us, unusually explicitly, that margins fall from 25.1%; a full-year 24–25% with H1 ~27–28% implies H2 nearer 21–23%. We weight management's downbeat tone over persistence.
- **Base-rate reasoning:** Naive persistence: a quarter's margin stays within ~1 pt of the prior quarter about 60% of the time.
- **Resolution rule:** YES if the EBITDA margin excluding forex and other income for Q3 FY27, as stated in Lupin's Q3 press release/call, is ≥24.0%. If not stated, compute (EBITDA − other income − forex gain) ÷ revenue from operations from the results.
- **Resolution source:** Lupin Q3 FY27 results press release / earnings call transcript
- **Sources used:** https://nsearchives.nseindia.in/corporate/Lupin2_06112026203743_SE_Intimation_of_Investor_Meet_Transcript.pdf; https://www.screener.in/company/LUPIN/consolidated/

Every open call has a spec, and all 191 specs pass the field, op, threshold-in-rule, ticker/symbol and date checks. The audit script is the scratch `audit.py`; it is not committed.
The checks were: required fields per kind; a valid op, and `between` has `threshold_hi`; the threshold appears in the written rule;
the op agrees with the rule wording; the metric is one the source returns; the Yahoo/NSE/SEC symbol matches the call; no `resolve_by` is in the past;
`check_from` is on or before `resolve_by` and after the period end.

By source (all 191): NSE XBRL + screener 55 auto; SEC XBRL 16 auto; Yahoo price 15 auto; NSE pledge 1, SEC 8-K item 1 and Yahoo dividend 1 auto
(the last two decide YES only; a NO is a proposal); NSE filings doc-scan 51 assisted + 25 human; SEC doc-scan 23 assisted + 3 human.

**Spec fixes (one-line edits in `specs.json`):** UTKARSHBNK `crar-mar27-16pct-plus` gained `op >= 16.0` and UTKARSHBNK `fy27-glp-growth-25pct-plus` gained
`op >= 24165`; both had no threshold, so they could never propose. XOM `q4-2026-adj-eps-above-q3` gained a phrase for "Adjusted earnings were … or $X.XX per share",
because the 3Q26 release no longer says "excluding identified items" and the old regex matched nothing. COFORGE `q3fy27-eight-large-deals-cred` gained a phrase for "8 large deals signed" and
"Eight large deals signed"; the old regex matched nothing on the Q2 release. MPHASIS `q3fy27-dso-below-100-cred` had a regex with no capture group, so it now captures the number.
After the fixes, the Q2 FY27 / 3Q26 replay proposes XOM 4.23, COFORGE 8 and MPHASIS 105. The MPHASIS 105 is the *normalised* DSO, which the rule excludes, so a human must check it. All 31 unit tests pass.
